item.title: Florida bill would require recess for all middle school students
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. (WFLA)— A bill was filed in the Florida Senate Chamber on Thursday requiring recess for middle school students. Sen. Kristen Arrington, of Osceloa County and part of Orange County, filed the bill that would require district school boards to provide a specialized amount of time for free-play recess each week. item.title: US intercepts fifth sanctioned tanker as it exerts control over Venezuelan oil distribution
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — U.S. forces boarded another oil tanker in the Caribbean Sea, according to the U.S. military on Friday, as the Trump administration continues to target sanctioned tankers traveling to and from Venezuela. The pre-dawn action was carried out by U.S. Marines and Navy, taking part in the monthslong buildup of forces in the Caribbean, according [...]

item.title: Jan. 6 riot 'Lectern Guy' files to run for Manatee County commission
item.description: A man shown in a viral photo carrying a podium from former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi's office during the U.S. Capitol riot on Jan. 6, 2021, filed to run for a Manatee County commission seat.

item.title: Popular tater tots recalled in Florida, 26 states due to plastic contamination: FDA
item.description: An Idaho company is recalling over 38,000 cases of tater tots sold in 26 states over possible contamination with bits of plastic, according to federal health officials.

item.description: BARTOW, Fla. (WFLA) — Gov. Ron DeSantis held a press conference in Bartow on Friday morning to announce the results of baby formula testing the state has been conducting. item.title: Florida officer leaves hospital after recovering from gunshot to the face
item.description: A Port St. Lucie Police sergeant left the hospital on Friday after recovering from a gunshot wound sustained on duty in early December.

item.title: Video shows Minneapolis shooting from ICE officer's perspective
item.description: The video, obtained by Alpha News, shows the officer exit his vehicle and approach Renee Nicole Macklin Good’s vehicle from the right. As the officer walks around to her driver’s side, Macklin Good’s window is down and she can be heard saying, “That’s alright dude, I’m not mad at you. I’m not mad at you.”

item.title: D-day veteran celebrates 101st birthday in Brooksville
item.description: David Jones celebrated his 101st birthday in Brooksville, surrounded by family and friends.

item.title: DHS IDs man, woman shot by federal agents in Portland
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security identified the two people shot by border patrol officers in Portland, Oregon on Thursday.

item.title: Florida sets execution date for man convicted of killing traveling salesman during robbery
item.description: A man convicted of killing a traveling salesman during a robbery is set to become Florida's first execution of 2026 under a death warrant signed Friday by Republican Gov. Ron DeSantis, who signed off on a record 19 executions last year.
